पद् (य, ङ, औ) पद्यते 4.
d. To go (क)
पदयति 10.
a. Idem. (ए) पदति
1.
a. To stand fast. With अभि
to know, to see; with अनु^1 to follow;
with आ^2 to happen, suffer, increase;
with उत्^3 to be born or produced;
with उप^4 to gain, be born; with प्र^5 to gain,
begin; with प्रति^6 to gain; restore;
promise; with वि^7 to suffer; with सं^8 to
perform, do; with उप^9 and with सं^10 to
offer oblations; with प्र^11 and with वि^12 to en-
act; with वि^13 and with आ^14 to kill; with वि^15 and
with उत्^16 to discriminate, analyze; with सं^17
and with आ^18 to arrive, finish.

पद (दं) 1.
n. A foot, a footstep; a
state, a place; a word; a mark;
a thing, &c.
m. Ray of light.

पाद (दः) 1.
m. A foot; a quarter;
[]
ray; the root of a tree; a fourth
of a stanza; a quadrant; a hill
at the foot of a mountain.

पदक (कः) 1.
m. A
brāhman know-
ing the
veda; a weight of gold;
ornament of the neck.

पद-कार (रः) 1.
m. Who divides or
separates compounds.

पद-ग (गः) 1.
m. A footman, or foot
soldier.
a. Walking.

पद-न्यास (सः) 1.
m. 1.
m. Step, pace,
conduct; posture; a plant.

पद-भञ्जन (नं) 1.
n. Explanation of ob-
scure words; etymology; sepa-
rating the words of a sentence.

पद-भञ्जिका (का) 1.
f. A register,
journal, calendar, almanac.

पद-ष्ठीव (वं) 1.
n. The feet and knees.

पदा_म्भोज (जं) 1.
n. Foot of a lady
or of a divinity.

पदार (रः) 1.
m. The dust of the
feet; a boat.

पदा_र्थ (र्थः) 1.
m. Thing; essence;
meaning; objects of natural
science; category.

पदिक (कः) 1.
m. A foot soldier.
n.
Point of the foot.
a. Walking.

पद्म (द्मः-द्मं) 1.
m. n. A lotus; ten billi-
ons; form of array; a treasure;
a spot on the body; a drug;
lead.
m. A
Nāga or serpent; a
Jaina. f. Lakshmī; a plant.

पद्मक (कः) 1.
m. Spots on an ele-
phant's face; a drug; leprosy.

पद्मा_कर (रः) 1.
m. A pond; lotus
pond; a large deep pond.

पद्म-काष्ठ (ष्ठं) 1.
n. A sort of drug.

पद्म-चारिणी (णी) 3.
f. A small tree
(Hibiscus mutabilis).

पद्म-तन्तु (न्तुः) 2.
m. Stalk of a lotus.

पद्म-नाभ (भः) 1.
m. A name of
Vish-
nu; a
Jaina of a future age.

पद्म-नाल (लं) 1.
n. The stalk of a lotus.

पद्म-पत्र (त्रं) 1.
n. A sort of costus.

पद्म-पाणि (णिः) 2.
m. A name of
Brah-
mā; the sun; a
Buddha.

पद्म-पुष्प (ष्पः) 1.
m. A shrub (Webera
corymbosa); a sort of bird.

पद्म-बन्ध (न्धः) 1.
m. Kind of alliter-
ation in the form of a lotus.

पद्म-वन्धु (न्धुः) 2.
m. A bee; the sun.

पद्म-रेखा (खा) 1.
f. A line in the
palm indicating wealth.

पद्म-लाञ्छन (नः) 1.
m. A king a
sovereign;
Brahmā; the sun;
Plutus, god of wealth.
f. Laksh-
mī; Saraswati; Tārā or
Durgā.

पद्मा_क्ष (क्षः) 1.
m. The lotus seed.
a. Lotus-eyed, having fine eyes.

पद्मा_ट (टः) 1.
m. A sort of cassia.

पद्मा_न्तर (रः) 1.
m. Petal of the lotus.

पद्मावती (ती) 1.
f. The wife of the
sage
Jaratkāru; name of a river.

पद्मा_सन (नं) 1.
n. Posture of
Bud-
dha in meditation; a lotus-like
throne.
m. Brahmā; the sun.

पद्मिन् (द्मी) 5.
m. An elephant.
f.
(द्मिनी) Many lotuses, lotus; its
pond; its stalk; a fine woman.

पद्मिनी-खण्ड (ण्डं) 1.
n. A place or dis-
trict abounding with lotuses.

पद्मे-शय (यः) 1.
m. A name of
Viṣṇu.

पद्मोत्तरा_त्मज (जः) 1.
m. One of the
Jaina Chakravartis or emperors.

पद्य (द्यं) 1.
n. Metre; infamy.
m. A
sudra. f. Praise; a road.
a. Com-
ing in contact with the feet.

पाद्य (द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
a. Water, &c. for
washing or cleaning the feet.

पद्र (द्रः) 1.
m. A village or its entrance.

पद्व (द्वः) 1.
m. Abode or world of
human beings; a car; a road.

पाद-कटक (कः) 1.
m. An ornament
for the feet or toes.

पाद-कृच्छ्र (च्छ्रं) 1.
n. A sort of pe-
nance, eating once and fasting
on alternate nights.

पाद-ग्रहण (णं) 1.
n. Respectful obei-
sance, touching the feet.

पाद-चत्वर (रः) 1.
m. A goat; sand
bank, religious fig tree; hail; a
slanderer, a calumniator.

पाद-चापल्य (ल्यं) 1.
n. Beating or
shuffling with the feet.

पाद-चार (रं) 1.
n. Daily position of
the planets, going on foot.

पाद-तल (लं) 1.
n. Sole of the foot.

पाद-त्राण (णं) 1.
n. A boot or shoe.

पाद-प (पः) 1.
m. A tree; a foot-
stool.
f. (पा) A shoe or slipper.

पाद-पाश (शः) 1.
m. A foot-rope for
cattle or horses; anklet of bells.
f. (शी) A fetter; carpet or mat.

पाद-पीठिका (का) 1.
f. A common
trade, as a barber; a white stone.

पाद-रज्जु (ज्जुः) 2.
f. An elephant's
heel ropes.

पाद-रथ (थः-थी) 1.
m. 3.
f. A shoe, or slipper.

पाद-शश्
adv. Verse by verse, stan-
za by stanza, foot by foot.

पाद-शैल (लः) 1.
m. A hill near or
at the foot of a mountain.

पाद-हत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Trodden on,
kicked; contemned.

पाद-हर्ष (र्षः) 1.
m. A tingling in the feet.

पाद-हारक (कः) 1.
m. One who
steals any thing with his feet.

पादा_ग्र (ग्रं) 1.
n. The point of the foot.

पादा_ङ्ग-द (दं) 1.
n. An ornament for
the feet or toes.

पादा_ङ्गुष्ठिका (का) 1.
f. Ring on the
great toe.

पादात् (त्) 5.
m. A foot-soldier, a foot-man.

पादा_ध्यास (सः) 1.
n. Treading on,
kicking; spurning.

पादारक (कः) 1.
m. Ribs of a boat.

पादा_वर्त्त (र्त्तः) 1.
m. A machine for
raising water from a well.

पादा_स्फालन (नं) 1.
n. Trampling,
shuffling; the motion of the feet.

पादिन् (दी-दिनी-दि)
a. Footed; hav-
ing four parts.
m. An amphibi-
ous animal; heir to a fourth.

पादुक (कः-का-कं)
a. Going; foot. (का)
f. A shoe or slipper.

पादो_दक (कं) 1.
n. Water for the
feet; water in which a
brāh-
man's feet have been washed.

पाद्य-पात्र (त्रं) 1.
n. A metal vessel
for washing the feet.
